assumption_audit.mechanism: At high daughter abundance the daughter nuclei absorb an increasing fraction of the incident neutrons, so inner nuclei experience a reduced flux; the effective per-nucleus capture rate decays as exp(-Nd/N_shield).
assumption_audit.parent_reduction: In the optically-thin limit N_shield -> infinity, exp(-Nd/N_shield) -> 1 and the term reduces exactly to the parent sigma_dp*Nd*Np.
